# Hierarchical_Interconnect

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A multi-level network topology within the chip that organizes communication between cores, routers, and memory in a scalable, structured manner. Enables scalable many-core integration and efficient data routing, directly impacting the topological design principles central to TCC research.
